description: This Java class defines a GUI component named GaugesGridElement that displays either a SensorGauge or a SensorLiveGraph within a panel. It includes methods for switching between gauge and live graph modes, manages configuration via Node objects, and interacts with external classes like Sensor and SensorGauge.

classes.name: GaugesGridElement
classes.description: A GUI component that toggles between displaying a sensor gauge or a live graph, based on configuration settings.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns a GUI component (gauge or live graph) based on the node configuration and default sensor.
